The C105 torsor factors canonically as C3 x C35 and the complement acts trivially on C3, forcing a canonical nine-triple organization of the 27 states. This matches the carrier architecture of the repo H27/Schlaefli transport, but the natural H(4) quotient adjacency is a different weighted transport and is not graph-isomorphic to either H27 or Schlaefli.
